description: Socio-Economic Indexes for Areas (SEIFA) is a dataset listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the Regional Data Hub group, published by Australian Bureau of Statistics (ABS). The ABS Socio-Economic Index for Areas (SEIFA) ranks areas according to their relative socio-economic advantage and disadvantage using Census data. SEIFA is created on a number of different geographic boundaries including Local Government Area (LGA), SA1, SA2, Suburbs and Postcodes. The publication includes interactive maps and data downloads. Coverage is Australia; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as less than annual, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2023-08-15. Files and pages listed: HTML (1 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
